category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, shorten the causal interest mean half-life from four interactions to three while retaining the 0.8 GRU-state and 0.2 interest-mean blend. This isolates recency sensitivity while preserving padding exclusion, causal prefixes, final-real-position inference, and all other model and training settings.

response.change_summary: Change only causal pooling half-life from four interactions to three and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor loader. Retain one GRU4Rec model per dataset.
